origine_fr: Un corps 尸 sur 者. Découper les bêtes : abattre, 屠宰, et, au pire, massacrer, 屠杀. 者 donnait le son, mais il se lit zhě, loin de tú.
origine_en: A body 尸 over 者. Cutting up animals: to slaughter, 屠宰, and at worst to massacre, 屠杀. 者 once gave the sound, but it is read zhě, far from tú.

phrase.en: He used to be a butcher.
